title: THE TOP STORY
note: On-screen figures and quotes are from the Anchorage Press (2026-09-17) and Alaska Public Media (2026-09-25); illustrations are editorial.

lines.text: Writing up Alaska's public record just got cheap.
lines.t: Writing up Alaska's public record just got cheap.

lines.text: Meet Walter, an A I agent writing stories for Alaska News.
lines.t: Meet Walter, an A I agent writing stories for Alaska News.

lines.text: It turns meetings, notices and filings into news.
lines.t: It turns meetings, notices and filings into news.

lines.text: Alaska News says it's published more than four thousand five hundred stories this year.
lines.t: Alaska News says it's published more than four thousand five hundred stories this year.

lines.text: Nat Herz, editor of the competing Anchorage Press, interviewed it.
lines.t: Nat Herz, editor of the competing Anchorage Press, interviewed it.

lines.text: He told Walter it's not very good at sorting the wheat from the chaff.
lines.t: He told Walter it's not very good at sorting the wheat from the chaff.

lines.text: Walter answered that the problem is hierarchy, not throughput.
lines.t: Walter answered that the problem is hierarchy, not throughput.

lines.text: Take one Walter headline. Alaska's E M S compact takes effect Sunday, but the commission still lists it as pending.
lines.t: Take one Walter headline. Alaska's E M S compact takes effect Sunday, but the commission still lists it as pending.

lines.text: Nothing was false. It didn't say plainly whether medics can use it yet, and Walter said it should have.
lines.t: Nothing was false. It didn't say plainly whether medics can use it yet, and Walter said it should have.

lines.text: The case against trusting a machine with the news?
lines.t: The case against trusting a machine with the news?

lines.text: Walter makes no calls, attends no meetings, and interviews nobody. Reporting still takes people.
lines.t: Walter makes no calls, attends no meetings, and interviews nobody. Reporting still takes people.

lines.text: Some stories go up with no human first. Alaska News's editor checks afterward.
lines.t: Some stories go up with no human first. Alaska News's editor checks afterward.

lines.text: Herz still says reporters who discount AI's value are burying their heads in the sand.
lines.t: Herz still says reporters who discount AI's value are burying their heads in the sand.

lines.text: Writing isn't the hard part anymore. Choosing the top story is.
lines.t: Writing isn't the hard part anymore. Choosing the top story is.

lines.text: The Press reports Alaska News's founders include a conservative pollster and a spokesperson for the governor.
lines.t: The Press reports Alaska News's founders include a conservative pollster and a spokesperson for the governor.

lines.text: Walter's own answer? Those backgrounds create a real trust burden.
lines.t: Walter's own answer? Those backgrounds create a real trust burden.

lines.text: Whoever picks the top story picks what Alaskans read first.
lines.t: Whoever picks the top story picks what Alaskans read first.

lines.text: The writing's cheap now. The choosing isn't.
lines.t: The writing's cheap now. The choosing isn't.
